name: Chenlun zhi Di
source:
A car accident shatters your peaceful life.

Just as your existence is crushed beneath the wheels, death does not claim you— it carries you to another world.

A wondrous medieval realm of fantasy.

This is where humans, beastmen, elves, and dwarves live side by side. Mages gaze out from towering spires, while monsters and dark gods watch from the shadows.

Was your journey here an accident… or a carefully orchestrated conspiracy?

Alongside you is a dire prophecy of apocalyptic doom.
 
Oblivion - where your adventure begins, also the place where all hope ends.

As a traveler from Earth, you venture into this fantastical world to uncover the truth behind it all.

[Edited from [url=https://qigiu.itch.io/descent-into-oblivion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场车祸打破了你平静的生活。

正如你的存在被碾压在车轮下一样，死亡并没有带走你——它会把你带到另一个世界。

一个奇妙的中世纪幻想王国。

这里是人类、兽人、精灵、矮人比邻而居的地方。法师们从高耸的尖塔中向外凝视，而怪物和黑暗之神则从阴影中注视着。

你来这里的旅程是一场意外……还是一场精心策划的阴谋？

在你身边的是一个关于世界末日的可怕预言。
 
湮没——你的冒险开始的地方，也是所有希望结束的地方。

作为来自地球的旅行者，你冒险进入这个奇幻的世界，揭开这一切背后的真相。
